title: OTHRYS OS Loop Weaving and processing optimization
objective: Map every current recurring/retry/AI-assisted runtime loop to Loop Laws, add a read-only loop registry and trace/diagnosis metrics, and identify deterministic compression opportunities without adding scheduler or execution authority.
problem: Loop Laws and component contracts are now explicit, but actual runtime loops are not yet inventoried, machine-mapped, trace-normalized or measured for redundant AI/tool activity.
risks: Generic loop abstraction hides different semantics
Trace capture leaks secrets or full prompts
Compression candidate is mistaken for admitted capability
laws: Actual code defines which loops exist; docs do not invent loops.
Every admitted runtime loop maps to a current component contract and LOOP_LAWS.md.
Loop traces contain bounded metadata/evidence references, not hidden reasoning or secrets.
Structured diagnosis precedes correction after causal failure.
Trace metrics optimize processing only and grant no authority.
Compression candidates remain candidates until separately qualified.

tasks.title: Map actual polling, cadence, retry and refinement loops from source

slices.title: Normalize loop evidence and failure diagnosis

tasks.title: Add authority-free trace/diagnosis schema and metrics
Flag repeated stable action families without auto-promotion
